text:
zoe: quick design question — i'm iterating on the latency dashboard controls. two choices: (A) keep time-range presets + a compact sampling dropdown, or (B) merge sampling into the timepicker as a paired control (sample density slider). which feels less clunky?

matt: i'm leaning B. users often choose sampling when they change ranges. pairing reduces clicks.

sam: B is neat but worried about discoverability. non-power users might not realize sampling affects heatmap fidelity. need inline help.

arie: agree with sam. if we go B, show a micro-help line under the slider: "sampling affects heatmap granularity and p95 stability" and add an info icon linking to docs.

julian: UX trade: a slider in timepicker may be awkward on mobile. can we fallback to a small menu for narrow viewports? also keyboard accessibility for the slider is critical.

zoe: good point. plan: slider in desktop timepicker, collapsed to a 3-dot menu on mobile that opens the same control. keyboard: arrow keys + page up/down for coarse steps.

matt: visual cue idea: when sampling < 0.5/sec, show a dashed overlay on heatmap and a subtle warning: "Low sampling — spikes may be exaggerated." not modal, just inline.

sam: copy suggestion for that warning: "Low sample rate may distort short spikes. Increase sampling for accurate p95." short + imperative.

arie: accessibility: whatever we do, ensure the sampling control has an accessible name and live region announcements when changed via keyboard so screen readers know the dashboard might redraw with lower fidelity.

julian: implementation note: backend can return an estimated sampleRate for the window. use that to set an initial slider position and to drive the dashed overlay threshold.

zoe: interaction question: if user selects a preset like "last 1h", should we auto-adjust sampling to recommended default for that preset? or leave as last-used?

matt: recommended defaults per preset are okay but respect explicit user overrides. i.e., set default on preset change but don't clobber if user had toggled manually.

sam: minor microcopy nits: call the slider label "Sample density" not "Sampling" — it's more descriptive. Tooltip: "higher = more raw events, slower rendering".

arie: i want a small affordance in the legend that toggles showing bucket outlines on hover only (not persistent). helps debug without changing preferences.

zoe: we'll prototype: timepicker with embedded density slider (desktop), mobile menu fallback, legend hover toggle, and low-sample dashed overlay + inline warning. matt/julian can you mock two variants: one with slider + preset auto-defaults and one with slider but no auto-defaults? gifs please.

design-bot: reminder: attach accessibility checklist to the PR (slider keyboard steps, aria-label, aria-live for redraw).

matt: on it. i'll post mocks before EOD PST.

zoe: awesome. meeting follow-up: decide copy and threshold numbers (e.g., dashed overlay at <0.5/sec). thanks all :raised_hands:
